correctness.rationale: For independent X=B-A,Y=C-A with covariance Σ=[[2,1],[1,2]], the two-by-two Wishart density and a sine-law Jacobian yield the exact density and normalize it. Orthogonal Gaussian Z=(X+Y)/sqrt2 and W=(X−Y)/sqrt2 give independent H~Beta(d/2,d/2), T~χ²(2d), and spherical cosine J. Obtusity at A is H<1/4; boundary Laplace with derivative 8/3 yields d(1/4−H)⇒Exp(4/3), hence dΔ⇒Exp(1). Independent chi-square and spherical CLTs give independent standard Gaussians for leg imbalance and scale; the angular cosine relation yields d(γ−π/2)⇒2Exp(1). Independently checked algebraic x,y,z coordinate identities to machine precision for d=2,5,17; simulation does not replace the proof.
